cutoff.description: Event-log entities (order_filled, orders_matched, split, merge, redemption, neg_risk_conversion, fee_refunded, fpmm_transaction, fpmm_funding_addition, fpmm_funding_removal) were exported with `WHERE timestamp <= this value`.

state_entities_reflect.description: State entities (wallet, user_position, orderbook, condition, fixed_product_market_maker, fpmm_pool_membership, neg_risk_event, market_open_interest, position, market, market_data, game, collateral, global_*, orders_matched_global) were read between cutoff.iso_timestamp and approx_iso_timestamp. The drift window is the difference — see drift_seconds.
